title: Jyothirmayuni Jananam – Lillian Christopher Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: శ్రీ యేసు రాజా నీకే స్తుతి స్తోత్రము
english: sri yesu raajaa neekey sthuthi sthothramu
intro: Jyothirmayuni Jananam is the Christian Telugu Christmas song from the album, Neethi Suryudu Na Yesaiah released in the year 2016 written & tuned by pastor Param Jyothi Gummalla, sung by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer Lillian Christopher and music composed by renowned Telugu christian music director, J K Christopher. This song video was released on October 28, 2020 through Sharon Sisters YouTube Channel.
